@realm:     Mentalism
@name:      Vision Guard
@category:  Base
@class:     Seer

 1 | Detect Scrying | 5'R | 1 min/lvl (C) | 50'R | P
 2 | Detect Divination | 5'R | 1 min/lvl (C) | 50'R | P
 3 | Cloud Scrying | 1 subject | 1 hr/lvl | touch | Fm
 4 | Conceal Fate | 1 subject | 1 hr/lvl | touch | Fm
 5 | Scrying Misdirection | 1 subject | 1 hr/lvl | touch | Fm
 6 | Shadow Past | 1 target | 1 min/lvl | touch | E
 7 | False Truth | 1 subject | 1 min/lvl | touch | Fm
 8 | False Anticipations | 1 subject | 1 rnd/lvl | touch | Fm
 9 | False Scrying | 1 subject | 1 hr/lvl | touch | Fm
10 | Cloud Portent | 1 subject | 1 hr/lvl | touch | Fm
11 | Feel Scrying | caster | constant | self | Pm
12 | Feel Divination | caster | constant | self | Pm
14 | Unknown Past | 1 target | 1 min/lvl | touch | E
15 | False Portent | 1 subject | 1 hr/lvl | touch | Fm
16 | Conceal Presence | 1 target | 1 min/lvl | touch | Fm
17 | Scrying Analysis | 1 scryer | - | self | Pm
18 | Divination Analysis | 1 diviner | - | self | Pm
20 | False Past | 1 target | 1 min/lvl | touch | E
25 | Conceal Memories | 1 target | 1 hr/lvl | touch | Fm
30 | False Memories | 1 target | 1 rnd/lvl | touch | Fm
50 | Outside the Weave | 1 subject | 1 hr/lvl | touch | E

# Descriptions
@@ 1
Detects if a being, item, or place in the area of effect is currently being
scried upon. The caster may concentrate on a different 5'R each round.
@@ 2
Detects if an attempt is being made to divine the future of a being, item, or
place in the area of effect. The caster may concentrate on a different 5'R
each round.
@@ 3
Allows the caster to cloud the scrying of a specific subject touched by the
caster at the time of casting this spell. If this spell is successful, the
scryer perceives his vision as if through a fog, gaining only 50% of the
knowledge that he would have gained if unimpeded. This protection lasts until
the duration runs out, the spell is cancelled (or dispelled), or the defense
is pierced by a scryer (whichever happens first).
@@ 4
Allows the caster to conceal one curse or destiny which lies upon the subject,
rendering the curse or destiny undetectable by Detect Curse or Detect Destiny.
The curse or destiny is still fully active, merely hidden to magical
detections.
@@ 5
Allows the caster to protect the chosen subject (touched at time of casting),
by if successful causing the scrying to go awry and lock onto a very similar
subject (the similar subject must be within 10' per level of the caster at the
time of the casting of this spell). The decoy subject will appear so similar
that the scryer must make a successful Altertness maneuver to realize his
mistake. If no suitable decoy exists, this spell will fail.
@@ 6
All deeds performed by the target (while this spell is active) are “shadowed”
to appropriate spells. For the purposes of appropriate spells (e.g., Death’s
Memory or Vision Behind), the information gained about the target will be
shrouded in shadows.
@@ 7
For the duration of this spell, if the target successfully resists any
“information-gathering” or “mind-reading” spells, he may portray falsehoods as
truths. If the caster of the mindreading spell is aware by other means that
the target must be deceiving him, or if the False Truth spell duration ends
before the mind-reading spell’s duration, the deception will be apparent.
@@ 8
This spell enables the target to mislead the caster of any Anticipate or
Anticipations spell. In the case of Anticipations spells, the caster receives
incorrect information with regard to the target’s intended actions. In the
case of Anticipate Blow, Anticipate Missile, Anticipate Spell,and Anticipate
Attack, the caster of these spells receives no benefit from casting these
spells (though the spells will be cast successfully, the benefit is negated by
negative penalties applied to the positive bonuses).
@@ 9
The caster may set a false vision upon the chosen subject for “would-be”
scryers to discover. The false vision must be fairly simple and may not
portray scenes or events longer than the duration of this spell. This spell
can be defeated by piercing or by repeated scrying (i.e., out-lasting the
duration of this spell), or noting that something unlikely is occurring, or
noting that events in the scrying repeat themselves exactly.
@@ 10
As Cloud Scrying, except the caster can cloud any form of divinatory magic
upon the subject.
@@ 11
Once learned, this spell allows the caster to know when any scrying attempt is
made upon him.
@@ 12
As Feel Scrying, except allows the caster to know when an attempt to divine
information about him is made.
@@ 14
As Shadow Past, except absolutely no information about the target will be
revealed. For example, a Death’s Memory cast on the scene of a murder might
show the victim collapsing with a knife in his chest (but no sign of the
knifewielder). The shrouding may be pierced, otherwise it is permanent.
@@ 15
Any attempt to divine information about the protected subject (touched at time
of casting) will receive a false reading, with the elements of the reading
specified by the caster at time of casting.
@@ 16
The target of this spell appears to have no presence for the duration of this
spell, and so may not be detected by Presence-type spells.
@@ 17
The caster may use this spell to determine the location and identity of a
scryer whose activities have been detected by either Detect Scrying, Feel
Scrying, or Power Perception.
@@ 18
As Scrying Analysis, except determines the location and identity of a diviner
whose activities have been detected by either Detect Divinations, Feel
Divinations, or Power Perception.
@@ 20
As ShadowPast, except all deeds performed by the target (while this spell is
active) will appear as if someone else is performing them. The false actor is
chosen by the caster at the time of casting and the effectiveness of the
falsification will depend on how well the caster can visualize the intended
“fall guy.” Merely observing someone is not as good as any of the following
spells: Study Pasty, Impersonation Study, or Change Lore.
@@ 25
The caster may use this spell to conceal the memories of the target from Inner
Thoughts, Mind Scan,and Mind Probespells etc. The caster may hide memories at
a rate of one scene per round (with a maximum number of rounds equal to the
caster’s level). The hidden memories are still available to the target.
@@ 30
As Conceal Memories, except the caster may replace real memories with false
memories at a rate of one memory per round. The target has access to both the
true and the false memories.
@@ 50
The subject of this spell is protected from all divinatory magic for the
duration of the spell. This spell lasts until it is cancelled, dispelled, or
the duration runs out (whichever is sooner), and may not be pierced. Any
divinatory magic attempted upon the subject will simply fail, and any
divinatory magic attempted upon other subjects where the protected subject may
directly or indirectly significantly effect the future of the protected
subject will provide answers which do not take the possible actions of the
protected subject into account. However the protected subject may not use
divinatory magic of any sort upon himself or other subjects for the duration
of this spell. The subject is truly outside the weave of fate.
